_comment: Mutation testing for the organisation-truth UI: the permission+flag gate, and the wizard's pure logic (recipe draft edits, link-rule edits, the data-quality verdict that decides whether the run may start) as the workstreams add it. WHY: a draft helper that silently drops a mapped column or a verdict that lets a run start with every owner unmatched produces an import that looks fine and links nothing. MUTATOR SET: StringLiteral and ObjectLiteral disabled, matching the sibling UI configs. SCOPE RULE: every new non-test .js/.jsx under src/components/orgtruth/ (and src/hooks/useCanImportOrgTruth.js) must be added to `mutate` here, or be given a written reason in `mutationExclusions` (mutationScope.guard.test.js in the API package matches paths exactly, no globs). Presentational panels go in exclusions, pure helpers and hooks go in mutate. NOT YET MEASURED: ships with the MVP; `break` is absent until a first run measures a score. Run: cd app/ui && npm run test:mutation:orgtruth

mutationExclusions.src/components/orgtruth/OrgTruthPage.jsx: Composition, not logic: tab state, the header button gated by the hook (which is mutated), and which panel shows. Covered end to end by OrgTruthPage.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/orgtruth/NotBuiltYet.jsx: Placeholder panel the workstreams replace; renders an EmptyState from two props and nothing else.
mutationExclusions.src/components/orgtruth/orgTabs.js: Declaration, not logic: the ordered list of the page's sub-tabs. The mount test asserts the exact list.
mutationExclusions.src/components/orgtruth/SourcesTab.jsx: Workstream T6 fills this panel; decide mutate vs exclusion (with a real reason) in the change that adds its logic.
mutationExclusions.src/components/orgtruth/ModelTab.jsx: Workstream T6 fills this panel; decide mutate vs exclusion (with a real reason) in the change that adds its logic.
mutationExclusions.src/components/orgtruth/EntitiesTab.jsx: Workstream T6 fills this panel; decide mutate vs exclusion (with a real reason) in the change that adds its logic.
mutationExclusions.src/components/orgtruth/ReviewTab.jsx: Workstream T6 fills this panel; decide mutate vs exclusion (with a real reason) in the change that adds its logic.
mutationExclusions.src/components/orgtruth/wizard/ImportWiz: Workstream T5 fills the wizard; its pure step logic goes in sibling helper files that are mutated, the composition stays here and is covered by its mount test.
